description: Static connect options for MMIR.ai, the orchestration layer for trusted AI. These are safe frontend options only; secrets and provisioning belong to protected backend services.

options.title: Install Local Connector
options.description: Open mmir.ai, connect local AI, install, ready. The universal installer detects Mac, Windows, Linux/VM, Raspberry Pi/Linux ARM or Android client mode, reads the release manifest, returns to MMIR after install, and only promotes a Mac DMG after a real MMIR Local Node artifact is published.

options.title: Connect local AI
options.description: Use a local connector profile for models running on your PC, Mac, Raspberry Pi, Linux ARM edge device or private VM. The connector pairs locally, discovers live models, routes chat through the MMIR API contract and can request an opt-in free tunnel when enabled locally.

options.title: Add compatible backend
options.description: Add a trusted MMIR-compatible backend URL for health, model discovery and chat once your connector/API follows the MMIR contract.

options.title: Use managed provider route
options.description: OpenAI, Claude, Gemini and similar providers require api.mmir.ai, auth and a protected key vault. Do not paste real provider keys into the public frontend.
